site.name: BAS1S Ventures public requests
site.indexDescription: Public requests BAS1S Ventures has already published. BAS1S Ventures is buying approximately US$10 million of OpenEvidence preferred shares, preferably through a direct secondary share transfer, at a target implied company valuation of approximately US$12 billion. This page is not a statement that a purchase has been agreed or completed.
readingNotes: Request pages on this site repeat a mandate that is already public and set their canonical URL to the original page. That avoids a second authoritative address for the same mandate. This index is a separate document. Its canonical URL is this page's address on the GitHub Pages project site.
Only requests that are already public are listed. This site does not accept submissions and does not collect personal or financial information.
A plain-text llms.txt file and a JSON file repeat the same public facts for readers that look for those formats. They do not ask for search ranking or automatic distribution.

requests.title: Buying OpenEvidence preferred shares
requests.description: BAS1S Ventures has published that it is buying approximately US$10 million of OpenEvidence preferred shares, preferably through a direct secondary share transfer, at a target implied company valuation of approximately US$12 billion.
paragraphs: Direct shareholders are invited to contact Wonder Xu at Bas1s Ventures. This page restates the public mandate for this index. It is not a statement that a purchase has been agreed or completed.

targetImpliedValuation.label: Approximately US$12 billion
targetImpliedValuation.meaning: Indicative acquisition valuation target. Not a statement of OpenEvidence's current market valuation or latest financing valuation.

notes.heading: What the valuation figure means
paragraphs: The US$12 billion figure is the indicative acquisition valuation target stated on the source page. It is not a statement of OpenEvidence's current market valuation or latest financing valuation. A price per share depends on the share class, its rights, the current capitalization and the agreed terms.

notes.heading: Who the mandate invites
paragraphs: The source page invites direct shareholders and authorized personnel of an entity that directly holds the shares. It says a shareholding vehicle that itself holds the underlying OpenEvidence preferred shares may act as a direct seller, and that selling interests in that vehicle is a different structure which this mandate does not invite. Brokers, intermediaries and introducers are not invited.

notes.heading: What this request does not say
paragraphs: The source page calls this an independent acquisition interest and states that BAS1S Ventures is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenEvidence. Any purchase remains subject to diligence, agreed pricing, applicable transfer restrictions, rights of first refusal, company consent and definitive documentation. Company approval is not represented. This site does not promise that a transfer will close.

contact.name: Wonder Xu
contact.note: The source page refers to the firm as Bas1s Ventures in the contact line and as BAS1S Ventures in the page title. They are the same firm on that page.
